description: Search, read, create, update, delete and comment on Confluence pages, browse spaces, page trees, attachments, versions, labels and user profiles on your *.atlassian.net/wiki site in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in Confluence session.

tools.name: list_spaces
tools.description: List Confluence spaces with optional pagination

tools.name: get_space
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Confluence space by its ID

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List Confluence pages. Optionally filter by space ID and sort by modified date. Returns paginated results.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Get a Confluence page by its ID, including title, metadata, and optionally the page body content in storage format (HTML)

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Create a new Confluence page in a space. The body content uses Confluence storage format (HTML).

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Update an existing Confluence page. Requires the current version number (get it from get_page). The body uses Confluence storage format (HTML).

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: Delete a Confluence page by its ID. The page is moved to trash and can be restored.

tools.name: get_page_children
tools.description: List the child pages of a Confluence page. Useful for navigating the page tree.

tools.name: list_page_attachments
tools.description: List attachments on a Confluence page. Returns file names, sizes, and download URLs.

tools.name: list_page_versions
tools.description: List version history of a Confluence page. Shows who edited the page and when.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Confluence content using CQL (Confluence Query Language). Examples: 'type=page AND text~"meeting"', 'type=page AND space="SD" ORDER BY lastmodified DESC', 'type=page AND title~"design"'. See https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/confluence/cql-fields/ for full CQL reference.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List footer comments on a Confluence page with optional pagination

tools.name: list_inline_comments
tools.description: List inline comments on a Confluence page. Inline comments are anchored to specific text in the page body. Filter by resolution status to see open, resolved, or dangling comments.

tools.name: list_comment_replies
tools.description: List replies (child comments) on a Confluence comment. Works for both inline and footer comments. Specify the comment type to use the correct API endpoint.

tools.name: create_comment
tools.description: Add a footer comment to a Confluence page, or reply to an existing comment. To create a new top-level comment, provide page_id. To reply to an existing footer comment, provide parent_comment_id instead. The comment body uses storage format (HTML).

tools.name: create_inline_comment
tools.description: Create an inline comment on specific text in a Confluence page. The comment is anchored to the selected text and appears as a margin note. Provide the exact text to anchor to, the total number of matches of that text on the page, and which match (0-based index) to anchor to.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Delete a footer comment from a Confluence page. The comment is permanently removed.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: List labels attached to a Confluence page

tools.name: add_label
tools.description: Add a label to a Confluence page

tools.name: remove_label
tools.description: Remove a label from a Confluence page by label name. Use list_labels to see which labels are on the page.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Get a Confluence user profile by account ID. If no account ID is provided, returns the current user profile.
